verdict.rationale: Adyen's core integration is server-to-server REST/API calls (no UI required) with idempotency-key support for safe retries and dedicated test credentials/test environment for automated integration testing, which together enable headless, scriptable, CI-friendly usage. However, there is no explicit documentation of CI/CD pipeline integration, automated test suites, or SDK tooling designed specifically for headless automation workflows. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guides, automated testing framework/SDK examples, and independent confirmation of headless automation use in production.
